usage_receipts_all_successful_requests.cost_semantics: OpenRouter BYOK upstream usage receipts; cache-sensitive; not an invoice

limitations: The 344 cases and labels were public and exposed during development; this is not blind validation.
One task cluster is excluded from paired quality because its Full response has no valid usage receipt; all other successful receipts remain in usage and cost totals.
LongBench structured-choice accuracy is not accepted coding-agent task quality.
Historical unreceipted requests are accounted for in the user-authorized cap but excluded from settled receipt totals.
The raw reports are private; source report hashes are provided for integrity checks.

The checked-in strict full-run analyzer is pinned to the parent manifest and expects one complete report; these aggregates were recomputed from the split reports using the same strict choice-scoring and task-cluster bootstrap rules, but the analyzer does not yet ingest this refreshed manifest and split-report layout directly.
